guideNote: Meta/Vault Guide.md carries guide_version in its frontmatter. On a re-run the installer replaces an installed guide whose version is lower than the shipped one, keeping the old file beside it. A guide with no guide_version is hand-written or predates versioning and is never touched without --replace-guide. Every vault also carries Meta/.brain.json recording the package and guide versions it is on.
vaultNamePattern: <email local part>-brain, lowercased with full stops removed, e.g. a.chen@ -> achen-brain
comment: Single source of truth for the vault's shape. Both installers read this rather than hard-coding folder names. Adding a folder here adds it to every new vault.

roles.comment: What the person mainly produces. NOT asked at install time: the installer copies every set into <vault>/Meta/.roles/ with tokens already substituted, and /brain-setup infers which one fits from the mailbox, calendar and Teams, confirms it with the person, then creates the folders in roles/<key>/folders.txt and copies roles/<key>/files/ into place. A role only ever ADDS, so nobody's vault is missing a place to put something. All five stay staged after one is applied, so another can be applied later without reinstalling.

tokens.name: VAULT_NAME
tokens.note: Folder name: the local part of OWNER_EMAIL, lowercased with full stops removed, plus -brain

tokens.name: VAULT_PATH
tokens.note: Absolute path to the vault: the home folder plus VAULT_NAME

tokens.name: SYNC_LOCATION
tokens.note: Where the real folder lives, or 'the vault folder itself' when there is no sync

skillsNote: Copied into <vault>/.claude/skills (read by Claude Code) AND zipped into <vault>/Meta/Setup for the employee to upload to their own claude.ai account, which is the only way the desktop app sees them. See docs/SKILLS-SETUP.md.
